title: Thai Vegan Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful Thai-inspired stir fry made with a variety of colorful vegetables and served with steamed jasmine rice.

ingredients.name: Mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, carrots, broccoli

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the Thai red curry paste and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the mixed vegetables and tofu. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Add the fresh Thai basil and stir-fry for another minute.
Serve the stir-fry over cooked jasmine rice.
